column1: # TFC c3b4d9536 src/generated/resources/data/tfc: the 32 aquatic species (16 fish of tfc:small_fish, 8 small and
# critter species of the water tags, 8 large aquatic or amphibious mobs). One row per species, from tfc/fauna/<species>.json and
# the entity_type tags. Blank field = key absent from the JSON (TFC default). months = number of months listed.
# entity_tags = the tags of the species' tfc:entity_type folder that list it, '-' if none.
# Rows: 32. Fauna files: 32 (each species has one).
